description: Implementation of LZ4 file decompression logic within the starboard elf_loader namespace, including context management, header parsing, decompression, and file reading functions.

classes.name: LZ4FileImpl
classes.description: Class handling LZ4 compressed file decompression, including context creation, header parsing, and data reading.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens and decompresses an LZ4 file given its filename.

methods.name: PeekHeaderSize
methods.description: Reads the file header to determine its size.

methods.name: ConsumeHeader
methods.description: Reads and processes the frame header to extract frame info.

methods.name: Decompress
methods.description: Performs the decompression of the file data.

methods.name: ReadFromOffset
methods.description: Reads decompressed data from a specific offset.
